in_marathi.name: Pranita
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Gift of Prana or Life force
in_marathi.long_meaning: Pranita हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Pranita is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'prana', which refers to the life force or energy that sustains all living beings. In Hindu mythology, Pranita is considered a divine name that embodies the spirit of life and creation. The name is believed to bring prosperity, good health, and happiness to the bearer.
